technical_and_design_decisions: Use Java 17+ and Spring Framework 6.x as per Spring Framework 6.0 requirements.
Adopt existing Spring XD architecture and build system (Maven/Gradle).
For reliable HDFS writes (U2), leverage Hadoop HDFS API and commit acknowledgment mechanism.
For multi-topic-partition consumption (U4), use Kafka consumer API with manual partition assignment.
For new DSL parser (U5), implement a two-pass parser (ANTRL-based or custom) that handles cross-referenced streams.
For partition function override (U3), extend the existing module interface to allow custom partition logic.
For ConfigurableConversionService (U7), ensure serialization/deserialization handles custom tuples via custom serializers.
Use JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) for JMX-enabled vs disabled benchmark (U8).
assumptions: Each user story is developed independently and sequentially in the order listed.
The developer has prior experience with Spring XD codebase and related technologies (HDFS, Kafka).
Effort estimates include design, coding, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation for each story.
Code review and basic refactoring are included in the estimates.
No external dependencies or infrastructure setup delays (e.g., Hadoop/Kafka clusters are available).
The benchmark in U8 is a one-time isolated test with documented results, not a continuous integration task.
All stories are well-defined and no major requirement changes occur during development.

activities.activity_name: U1: Remove list of modules from BaseDefinition and reparse
activities.activity_description: Refactor BaseDefinition to remove the pre-parsed list of modules and instead reparse module definitions as needed. Update downstream code that depends on the list.

activities.activity_name: U2: Reliable HDFS writes with commit acknowledgment
activities.activity_description: Implement HDFS write functionality that guarantees acknowledgment of commits (not just message bus commits). Integrate with stream pipelines and provide configuration options.

activities.activity_name: U3: Override partition function in source/processor module
activities.activity_description: Allow developers to override the default partition function within a source or processor module so data can be sent to a specific partition. Extend module API and provide documentation.
Enable a consumer to subscribe to multiple topic-partitions and serve data via a single queue. Implement partition assignment logic and handle offset management.

activities.activity_name: U5: New DSL parser for Flo UI
activities.activity_description: Design and implement a new DSL parser that can handle separately parsed stream definitions with cross-references (e.g., tap). Support detection of incorrect module/option values.

activities.activity_name: U6: Design and document stream deployment in a single container
activities.activity_description: Analyze and document the approach for deploying all modules of a stream within a single container (co-location). Produce design document and architectural guidelines.

activities.activity_name: U7: Handle non-default ConfigurableConversionService tuples after deserialization
activities.activity_description: Ensure that custom tuples registered in ConfigurableConversionService are preserved and not reset after deserialization. Implement uniform handling mechanism.

activities.activity_name: U8: Benchmark stream with and without JMX enabled
activities.activity_description: Set up a benchmark to measure stream performance with JMX enabled versus disabled. Run tests in isolation and document performance differences.
